in_arabic.name: Mafazah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mafazah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'afaza', meaning 'to protect' or 'to shelter'. In Islamic tradition, the name Mafazah signifies the idea of protection and shelter, often referring to Allah's divine care and guidance.
